 Sacramento Kings Los Angeles Lakers Luka Doncic and the Los Angeles Lakers have the No. 1 offense in the NBA in the 2026-27 season, and they’ve won back-to-back games heading into Wednesday’s road date with rookie Darius Acuff Jr. and the Sacramento Kings.
--> Luka Doncic and the Los Angeles Lakers have the No. 1 offense in the NBA in the 2026-27 season, and they’ve won back-to-back games heading into Wednesday’s road date with rookie Darius Acuff Jr. and the Sacramento Kings.
 Sacramento earned its first win of the 2026-27 season against the Dallas Mavericks on Monday, and Acuff has been scoring at a high level even though his efficiency is still coming along at the NBA level. The Kings are a weird team since they have several veterans they make look to move on from this season, and it has put them in the conversation for the relegation zone in the NBA (bottom-three in record).

 Meanwhile, the Lakers are looking to contend for a title with a new-look roster tailored to Doncic’s strengths. The star guard leads the league in scoring and is now the MVP favorite after two weeks of action.
